description: This Dart source file defines classes and logic for managing download items within a Flutter application. It includes data models for download items, their statuses, and a controller to handle download queue management, persistence with SQLite, and interaction with a download engine.

classes.name: DownloadStatus
classes.description: Enumeration representing the various statuses a download can have (queued, downloading, completed, etc.).

classes.name: DownloadItem
classes.description: Data model for a download, including ID, title, status, progress, and timestamps. Includes factory method for creation from database rows and method to convert to a database row.

classes.name: DownloadController
classes.description: Controller class managing the download queue, persisting state with a database, and interacting with a download engine to start, pause, resume, and restore downloads. It uses ChangeNotifier for state updates.

methods.name: restoreFromDisk
methods.description: Restores persisted download queue and item states from the SQLite database; also resumes in-progress downloads if queue isn't paused.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new download item to the queue and starts the download if the queue is not paused.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a download item from the database and cancels any in-progress download.

methods.name: togglePaused
methods.description: Toggles the global download queue pause state and updates ongoing downloads accordingly.

methods.name: pauseItem
methods.description: Pauses a specific download item without affecting the global queue state.

methods.name: resumeItem
methods.description: Resumes a specific paused download if the global queue is not paused.

methods.name: _setStatus
methods.description: Updates the status and timestamp of a specific download item in the database.

methods.name: _upsertProgress
methods.description: Updates the progress, bytes downloaded, and status of a download in the database based on current progress.

methods.name: _startSimulation
methods.description: Initiates a simulated download process via the download engine and updates progress callbacks.
